atmospheric_profiles.construction_method: For the distinct copied AM 12.2 family, 25 AMC files cross annual/DJF/MAM/JJA/SON with H2O percentiles 5/25/50/75/95. They cite MERRA-2 inst3_3d_asm_Np v5.12.4, 2007-2016, per-pressure-level H2O percentiles and median O3, and contain complete pressure-layer bytes. Post-hoc P1 varied only Nscale troposphere h2o and directly ran all 100 target/profile fitted-scale grids. The completed successor study freezes and evaluates fixed_djf25_v1 and conditioned_djf_v1, with 155 validated P1 training grids and 240 new direct holdout grids; neither lane is selected. For the earlier P1 correction metric, q25/q50/q75 candidate tau is direct AM atmTaun while generic truth tau is reconstructed as -log(atmTtx); q95 reconstructs both nominal ratio sides as -log(Tband/T225). The frozen P1 report/manifest's broader tau wording is superseded by this package-level clarification. Mapping to the four generic q artifacts remains unestablished.
atmospheric_profiles.historical_source_evidence: The copied annual/seasonal AM 12.2 profiles and their construction comments are complete and digest-bound. TolTECA registry identity proves the copied seasonal and annual products are separate from generic am_q25/am_q50/am_q75/am_q95. It does not establish whether the same historical generator lineage produced the generic products. The owner-authorized separately versioned AM 12.2 successor study is complete with numerical_adoption_evidence_fail while generic q95 and exact generic custody remain unresolved nonblocking historical provenance; the successor is not represented as a historical regeneration of the generic products.
